faqItems.q: Where can I buy Rayhana products?
faqItems.a: Amazon US, Canada, Australia, Germany and UK, and Shopino24 Afghanistan. Choose your product and delivery country; check availability and delivery to your exact address in the store.

faqItems.q: Why was a country suggested, and can I change it?
faqItems.a: The suggested country uses your approximate location and may be wrong. Change it to your order’s destination; page language does not determine delivery country.

faqItems.q: Which pot size should I choose?
faqItems.a: Listed capacities are 7 L, 9 L and 12 L. Consider how much you cook and your hob and cupboard space; check availability of your chosen model and size in the store.

faqItems.q: Can I use the pot on gas and induction hobs and in the oven?
faqItems.a: Suitable for cooking on gas and induction hobs. Oven use up to 180°C / 356°F, according to the product guide. Handles can get hot. Use Rayhana silicone grips or heat-resistant gloves. Never heat the pot empty.

faqItems.q: How do I use the mandoline safely?
faqItems.a: Place it on a stable surface and always use the food holder. Keep your fingers away from the blade. Cut-resistant gloves provide additional protection but are not cut-proof and never replace the holder. Read the full guide before adjusting, cutting or cleaning.

faqItems.q: What is Rayhana’s Black Friday offer?
faqItems.a: Rayhana Amazon stores: 10% off 1 pot, 15% off 2, 25% off 3; the mandoline has a separate 25% offer. Shopino24 Afghanistan: a flat 15% on eligible pots, whatever the quantity. The mandoline offer is separate and does not count toward the pot quantity. Pot offer: 27–30 November 2026; Amazon mandoline dates are pending confirmation. faqItems.q: Must I buy or write a review to join Rayhana Table?
faqItems.a: No. Purchases, Amazon reviews and social sharing are neither required nor rewarded. Each step earns 25 points once; the badges are symbolic only.
